description: Ironwood -> Ironwood shielded transfer transaction (v6, ironwood_v3, PostNu6_3 circuit). Built and signed with this codebase's CLI (one Ironwood spend, one shielded output back to the wallet's diversifier 1, no transparent I/O), proven locally with the orchard-proving feature, broadcast to a live Zcash testnet zebrad node via sendrawtransaction and mined at block 4532252 under the NU7 consensus branch.
